mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as lower capital costs boost corporate earnings multiples.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 8.0% signal deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending capacity and corporate profit growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in UNRATE > 8.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST < 580.0) and industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0) indicate weakening aggregate demand and manufacturing activity, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic growth forecasts.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in HOUST < 580.0 and INDPRO < 98.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high interest rate environments (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a subsequent decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and declining periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 210.0 indicates elevated inflation pressures that prompt central bank tightening, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL > 210.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment (PAYEMS < 130000.0) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 10.0) signal labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in PAYEMS < 130000.0 and UNRATE > 10.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 (INDPRO < 95.0) indicates manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate output capacity and profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in INDPRO < 95.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 580.0 (HOUST > 580.0) indicate robust residential construction demand that boosts economic growth and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in HOUST > 580.0 periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
